definitions.gloss: to recall, to remember, to recollect
definitions.explanation: To bring a memory back to mind. Focuses on the active process of retrieving a memory, rather than simply having memorized something.

examples.japanese: ⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{思|おも}い→思い：10248_omoi⟧⟦{出|だ}した→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
examples.english: I recalled things from the past.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive). Pattern: X⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{思|おも}い{出|だ}す (recall X). Compound verb: ⟦{思|おも}う→思う：00492_omou⟧ + ⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧.

ASPECT: ⟦ている→ている：noentry⟧ indicates ongoing action or state. ⟦{思|おも}い→思い：10248_omoi⟧⟦{出|だ}して→出す：01087_dasu⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ = 'is recalling' or 'has recalled.'

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{思|おも}い{出|だ}す (recall the past)
- ⟦{思|おも}い→思い：10248_omoi⟧⟦{出|だ}せない→出す：01087_dasu⟧ (can't remember)
- ⟦ふと→ふと：00048_futo⟧{思|おも}い{出|だ}す (suddenly remember)
- {思|おも}い{出|だ}す⟦たびに→たびに：22222_tabini⟧ (every time I remember)

CONTRAST WITH ⟦{覚|おぼ}える→覚える：00739_oboeru⟧:
- ⟦{覚|おぼ}える→覚える：00739_oboeru⟧: to memorize, to learn (putting into memory)
- {思|おも}い{出|だ}す: to recall (retrieving from memory)

RELATED NOUN: ⟦{思|おも}い{出|で}→思い出：00331_omoide⟧ (memory, recollection)
